svg.title: Recorded switchboard demo terminal run
svg.desc: A Linux terminal capture of switchboard demo. It reports NO-GO, three failures labelled Value, Schema, and Order, runtime and peak RSS measurements, and one global_sort streaming-plan warning.
svg.text: recorded local terminal · Linux / Python 3.12 / Pandas 3.0.5 / Polars 1.44.1

g.text: Measured facts determine the decision. Heuristics only request review.
